goal: You want to use OAW as a manager for your own skills in a project that has no OAW installation. Add the two local skills with oaw.py add --choice only --consent scripts --apply, inspect list and doctor, then remove the additions.
setup:
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files = {'local-skills/notes/SKILL.md': '---
name: notes
description: Organize project notes into a short reading list.
---

Read the notes and group them by topic.
', 'local-skills/scripty/tool/SKILL.md': '---
name: scripty
description: Summarize a local log file.
---

Run `python3 scripts/run.py LOG`.
', 'local-skills/scripty/tool/scripts/run.py': "print('Local log summary')
"}
for name, content in files.items():
    path = Path(name)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
PY
